summary: Nakhchivan State University (NSU) is a public university in the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, Azerbaijan. It was founded in 1967 as part of the Azerbaijan Pedagogical Institute and became Nakhchivan State University in 1990. The note reports it has 290 faculty members and 3500 students, and describes a 2003 Education-Information Center opened with George Soros' Open Society Institute - Assistance Foundation.
one_line: Overview of Nakhchivan State University, a public university in Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic founded in 1967.
key_facts: Nakhchivan State University (NSU) is a public university located in the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, Azerbaijan.
Nakhchivan State University's Azerbaijani name is "Naxçıvan Dövlət Universiteti".
Nakhchivan State University was founded in 1967 as a part of the Azerbaijan Pedagogical Institute.
In 1990, the institution became the Nakhchivan State University.
Nakhchivan State University has 290 faculty members.
Nakhchivan State University currently enrolls 3500 students.
In 2003, Nakhchivan State University, in conjunction with George Soros' Open Society Institute - Assistance Foundation, opened an Education-Information Center on its campus.
The Education-Information Center opened in 2003 at Nakhchivan State University was intended to develop areas involving education, information and law.
